description: This plot illustrates the Mean Interclass Similarity across various Relation Categories for three different configurations, alongside their respective averages. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category," employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Mean Interclass Similarity," also uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six lines in total: three solid lines representing the data points for each configuration and three dashed lines representing their overall averages. The "w/o DPO obo" configuration is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers; it exhibits high variability, starting at approximately 0.22 at x=0, reaching prominent peaks near 0.49 at x=1 and 0.48 at x=31, and ending at roughly 0.02 at x=64. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" configuration is shown as a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangular markers; it starts at 0.10 at x=0, displays significant fluctuations with major peaks at x=31 (0.46) and x=60 (0.47), and concludes at approximately 0.08 at x=64. The "DPO" configuration is represented by a solid green line with star-shaped markers; it demonstrates generally lower values and less extreme variance, beginning at 0.19 at x=0, peaking at 0.21 at x=1, and ending at 0.06 at x=64. Additionally, three thin, dashed horizontal lines indicate the average values for each configuration across the entire x-axis: the blue dashed line ("Average of w/o DPO obo") remains constant at 0.107, the orange dashed line ("Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint") remains constant at 0.158, and the green dashed line (representing the average for DPO) remains constant at 0.086.
